components: Sends API calls for one authenticated user
Validates identity and derives the stable user key
Selects rate and burst from the user product tier
Shares token state across devices and sessions
Atomically consumes allowance for the operation cost
Receives only calls within the user allowance

nodes: A validated user identity becomes the limiter key.
The product tier selects rate, burst, and operation cost.
All sessions and devices consume the same user allowance.
Requests within allowance proceed and excess requests are throttled.
